Ba-Pef
Ba-Pef
was a minor underworld
god
in
Egyptian mythology
. The name literally means
that
Ba
, meaning
that soul
(
ba
). Ba-Pef is commonly portrayed as an obscure malevolent deity known from the
Old Kingdom
. During the Old and Middle Kingdom the priesthood of Ba-Pef was held by queens.
